title: Advocate Or Semi-Qualified Chartered Accountant
description:
**Company Description**
Tuteja Jain & Co. is a professional services firm based in Sonipat, offering audit, taxation, accounting, and advisory services to a diverse portfolio of clients. The firm focuses on delivering accurate, compliant, and practical solutions that help businesses and individuals manage their financial and regulatory responsibilities. Team members work closely with clients to understand their operations and provide tailored guidance. The firm values integrity, technical proficiency, and continuous learning, creating an environment where professionals can grow their careers in accounting, tax, and law. Tuteja Jain & Co. encourages initiative and professionalism, offering exposure to a wide range of assignments and industries.

**Role Description**
The Advocate or Semi-Qualified Chartered Accountant will handle day-to-day work related to accounting, taxation, audit, and compliance for clients of the firm. Responsibilities may include preparing and reviewing financial statements, handling direct and indirect tax filings, supporting statutory and internal audits, drafting and reviewing legal and tax documentation, and assisting in advisory assignments. The role involves liaising with clients and authorities, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring deadlines and regulatory requirements are met. The professional will also support senior team members in research, case preparation, and opinion drafting, while keeping up-to-date with relevant laws and regulations. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Sonipat.

**Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting, with hands-on experience in bookkeeping and preparation of accounts.
* Working experience in direct and indirect taxation, including return filing, assessments support, and basic tax planning.
* Exposure to statutory, tax, or internal audits, including documentation, testing of controls, and preparation of working papers.
* Ability to research and interpret relevant laws, rules, and regulations, and apply them to practical client situations.
* Proficiency in common accounting and office software (e.g., Tally or similar accounting tools, Excel, Word) and comfort with digital documentation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to draft clear reports, correspondence, and basic legal or tax documents.
* Good analytical and problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and commitment to accuracy and compliance.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team, manage multiple assignments, and meet deadlines in a structured professional environment.
* For Semi-Qualified Chartered Accountant: completion of relevant CA intermediate levels and practical training; for Advocate: law degree and enrollment with the appropriate bar council (or eligibility to enroll).
* Prior experience in a CA or legal firm, or internship exposure to audit, tax, or corporate law, will be considered an advantage.

title: Finance Business Unit Controller
description:
**Major Objective:**

Responsible to analyse, prepare business case for Product Group and drive profitability.

**Main Tasks:**

• Plan and implement systems and process to improve growth of business.

• Establish working rapport with business partners across company.

• Work as business partner for all Product groups.

• Prepare statistical analysis of plans and financial results and management report.

• Prepare and analyse business case in line with growth plan.

• Compile, challenge and monitor business cases as well as financial scenarios that enable business decision.

• Prepare Business plan and valuation such as Break even analysis, Free cashflow, Present value, Payback, IRR, ROCE, ROS.

• To assist CFO, MD and Business Unit Lead in decision making.

• HK1 and beyond HK1 costing.

• Participate in gate reviews to ensure the SOP of the programs are in line with the approved gate workings.

• Prepare long term plan, draw actions to meet and improve profitability.

• Prepare analysis to ensure new projects are viable or not.

• Business Unit / Product Group wise variance reports such as Actual vs Budget vs Business Case.

Required Qualification:

• CA /CMA with 8-14 years of experience in financial analysis and business case preparation.

• Financial analysis and business case preparation.

• Strong analytical and logical approach with high degree of accuracy.

• Ability to analyse profitability, financial scenarios, contribution margin and variances.

• Well-developed PowerPoint and Excel skills; knowledge of Power BI will be an advantage.

title: Chartered Accountant
description:
**Position:**
Chartered Accountant (CA)

**Department:**
Finance & Accounts

**Location:**
Asoda Todran, Bahadurgarh, Haryana

**Experience:**
5+ Years

**Job Purpose:**

**To manage and oversee financial accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, financial reporting, internal controls, budgeting, and other finance-related activities of the organization while ensuring accuracy and compliance with applicable laws and company policies.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage day-to-day accounting and financial transactions.
* Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
* Ensure timely closure of books of accounts.
* Manage GST, TDS, Income Tax, PF, ESIC and other applicable statutory compliances.
* Handle GST returns, reconciliations, assessments, notices and related documentation.
* Coordinate with statutory, internal and tax auditors.
* Prepare MIS reports, financial analysis and management reports.
* Monitor accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash flow and bank reconciliation.
* Review purchase, sales, expenses, inventory and other accounting entries.
* Monitor and strengthen internal financial controls.
* Assist in budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.
* Ensure proper accounting and valuation of inventory, including raw material, WIP and finished goods.
* Review costing and profitability of products/projects where required.
* Coordinate with banks and financial institutions for banking-related matters.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Companies Act, Income Tax Act, GST Act and other relevant regulations.
* Support management in financial planning and decision-making.
* Identify financial risks and recommend corrective actions.
* Maintain proper records and documentation for audits and statutory requirements.
* Work closely with HR, Purchase, Stores, Production and Sales teams on finance-related matters.
* Ensure timely payment of statutory dues and vendors.
* Any other finance and accounting responsibilities assigned by management.

**Required Qualifications:**

* **CA – Chartered Accountant (ICAI).**
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce/Finance preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Accounting, GST, TDS and Income Tax.
* Good knowledge of Excel and ERP/accounting software.
* **Manufacturing industry experience will be preferred.**
